payload.title: One Honest Edition
payload.summary: You run one newspaper shift: verify a correction, choose space for a useful notice, and handle an interruption before the edition closes. The shift ends with an actual bounded edition.

expectations.summary: You run one newspaper shift: verify a correction, choose space for a useful notice, and handle an interruption before the edition closes. The shift ends with an actual bounded edition.
commitments: Fictional decisions; no currency or player property is at stake.

quality.question: What can this edition truthfully publish while still serving its readers?

assumptions.text: All times use the same local clock unless a record explicitly gives a correction.
Only named people and mechanisms in the case can be required for its resolution.

clauses.text: A cargo-loading cancellation does not imply cancellation of passenger travel.

identity.emotionalTurn: A dramatic headline gives way to useful public work

motives.label: Protect people affected by the case

questions.text: Yesterday’s paper printed “ferry canceled.” The harbor order canceled only the cargo loading. Which correction preserves that distinction?
There is space for one complete service notice. Both are verified. Your choice changes what this edition helps readers do.
The clinic admits residents until 21:00 and requires no appointment. Which sentence is supportable?
The shelter’s front stairs are closed; its signed level side entrance remains open. Choose usable directions.
A caller names a supposed saboteur but provides no record. The compositor asks whether to stop the verified service notices for it.
The printed edition carries the correction, your chosen useful notice and a clear boundary around the unverified tip. The shift is finished, not converted into an endless delivery task.
